title: New major hospital, Brisbane: excavation
workplace: New major hospital with a hospital tower, two level basement and rooftop helipad, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Bulk excavation for the basement
swms.task: Bulk excavate the two level basement with excavators and trucks, next to the street and neighbouring buildings, installing ground anchors in the retention wall as the excavation goes down, with the basement edge more than 2 m deep.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed along the basement edge before the excavation is more than 2 m deep, and ramps and stairs with handrails give access.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.excavationPlan: Excavation follows the geotechnical design G-110 (revision C) in stages to the levels shown, with anchors installed and stressed before digging below each row, and plant and trucks follow the site traffic management plan TMP-02.

steps: Install and later remove ground anchors
Protect the basement edge and provide access
Protect neighbouring buildings and the street
